about: Expected verdicts for bench/judge.mjs, labelled once on 2026-10-22 and frozen: candidates do not edit this file.
match: true means the pair should pass with no changed pixels allowed at the defaults; false means it should fail.
benchmark: the 193 pairs of bench/accuracy.mjs (design and held-out sets), keyed by bench/corpus.mjs ids, with the benchmark's own labels.
synthetic: bench/synthetic.mjs, labelled by the finding each pair reproduces.
synthetic also holds the judge's own textured drift and its control, generated in bench/judge.mjs.

real: captures from a downstream renderer, not in this repository, keyed by the first 16 hex digits of the SHA-256 of each PNG (expected-actual), so a label applies only to the exact bytes it was given for. golden: pairs of captures of identical input.

synthetic/1/surface opacity 35% → 30%.why: Finding 1: a translucent surface 35% → 30% opaque, nothing moved: a real change of colour (issue #2): should not match.

synthetic/1/surface panned 0.3 px.why: Finding 1's control: the same scene panned 0.3 px, nothing else changed: a sub-pixel shift: should match.

synthetic/2/label moved a pixel.why: Finding 2: identical input, a label anchor lands either side of a pixel boundary and moves a whole pixel: self-noise, labelled should match as the benchmark does. Failing it is defensible.

synthetic/2/label box one row taller.why: Finding 2: identical input, a label box edge crosses a pixel centre in one load only: self-noise, labelled should match as the benchmark does. Failing it is defensible.

synthetic/3/terrain, snapped vertices.why: Finding 3: the same terrain through a rasteriser that snaps vertices to 1/16 px and one that does not, under 1/32 px of movement: should match.

synthetic/3/geofence, snapped vertices.why: Finding 3: the same scene with an aliased translucent overlay through the two rasterisers; edge rows flip: rendering noise, should match.

synthetic/4/bilinear in half precision.why: Finding 4: bilinear magnification exactly and in half precision, every channel within one level: rounding, should match.

synthetic/judge/textured drift of 1–3 le.why: Generated by bench/judge.mjs: a dark textured frame with every channel one to three levels lighter, nothing moved. A drift of two levels or more over an area is a real change of colour and must be counted: should not match.

synthetic/judge/fine texture moved 0.3,.why: Generated by bench/judge.mjs, the control for the textured drift: a finely textured frame and the same scene moved 0.3 px right and 0.2 px down, area-sampled. A true sub-pixel move, with about 230,000 pixels past ΔE00 1, so a build cannot pass the drift by counting everything: should match.
